# Text Input Fixes - Jan 28, 2026

**File Modified:** `FloydDesktopWeb/src/App.tsx`

## Problem
- Text input box was too narrow, making it hard to type
- Cursor was being cut off at the bottom half

## Changes Made

### Width Fixes
- Added `min-w-0` class to allow flexible shrinking
- Added `w-full` class to take full available width
- Added inline `style={{ minWidth: '200px' }}` to ensure minimum width

### Height/Visibility Fixes
- Changed `rows={1}` to `rows={3}` for more typing space
- Increased vertical padding from `py-3` to `py-4`
- Increased minimum height from `80px` to `100px`
- Set `height: 'auto'` for flexible sizing

### Result
Text input now:
- Expands to fill available space
- Has minimum 200px width and 100px height
- Has adequate padding for cursor visibility
- Comfortable typing experience

## Code Location
Lines ~831-847 in App.tsx (textarea element with className and style props)
